response.overview: Set in the 80’s, the story follows two friends who spend the night in a meadow looking for UFOs while listening to the radio. Between conversations, silences and confidences, fears, doubts and secrets that they had never dared to share begin to emerge. What begins as any night ends up becoming an emotional journey to acceptance and the freedom to show oneself as one is.
response.title: La conexión Intergaláctica
